message.content: The interscapular pain started two days ago. The leg weakness got worse until I couldn't stand anymore, and I started having trouble with my bowels and bladder, but I'm not sure exactly how fast that happened. I don't have any fever, infections, trauma, cancer, blood clotting problems, or take any blood thinners. I'm not on any medications either.
